issues.quote: (the meeting at the end of the sprint where the team shows what it finished)
issues.text: New gloss of a Scrum event, not in the claims ledger. The 2020 Guide: 'The Sprint Review is the second to last event of the Sprint' (the Retrospective comes after) and 'The Scrum Team presents the results of their work to key stakeholders and progress toward the Product Goal is discussed.' 'at the end' is loose but not false; 'shows what it finished' matches 'cannot be released or even presented at the Sprint Review' for unfinished items.
issues.fix: Change to '(the meeting near the end of the sprint where the team shows what it finished)' and add a claim (version_key scrum, section 5): 'Sprint Review is the second to last event of the Sprint; the Scrum Team presents the results of its work; an item not meeting the Definition of Done cannot be presented.'
